name: Smuth Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About SMUTH CREAM

SMUTH CREAM is a combination of Calcium Dobesilate, Hydrocortisone Acetate, Lignocaine and Zinc Oxide which belong to the group of medicines called Anti-haemorrhoids. It is used to manage haemorrhoids or piles (lumps inside or around your anus) and anal fissures (a small tear in the lining of anus) and constipation.

SMUTH CREAM is not recommended for use if you have tuberculous or fungal lesions or skin vaccinia (viral infection), varicella (chicken pox) and acute herpes simplex infection. Consult with your doctor before using it.

SMUTH CREAM should be used with caution in patients with lung, liver and heart problems. SMUTH CREAM should be used during pregnancy only if clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before using it.

SMUTH CREAM is not recommended for use in children under 12 years of age. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of using SMUTH CREAM are burning, irritation, redness, itchiness at the application site. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of SMUTH CREAM

Manage:

Haemorrhoids
Anal fissures
Constipation
mechanismOfAction:
How SMUTH CREAM Works

Calcium Dobesilate is a vasoprotective medicine that works by strengthening the blood vessels at the affected site and also promote fast healing. Lignocaine is a local anaesthetic blocks the transmission of pain signals from nerves to brain and Hydrocortisone belongs to the class of steroids works by decreasing itching, inflammation, redness and swelling. Zinc oxide is an astringent, which helps to reduce painful swelling and shrink the haemorrhoids. It also protects the skin on the anus from infections. Thus SMUTH CREAM helps to shrink pile mass and heals anal fissure effectively.
usageDetails:
How to use SMUTH CREAM

Apply SMUTH CREAM as advised by your physician. It is for topical use only. Wash your hands before and after use. Apply a thin layer of this medicine over the affected area with the help of an applicator or as directed by physician. Avoid the medicine in contact with your eyes, ears, nose or mouth. If accidental exposure occurs, wash your eyes with water and seek immediate medical attention.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before using SMUTH CREAM, inform your doctor if you are using any of the following medicine:

Medicine used to manage chest pain, high blood pressure (Ex. nitroglycerin, nitroprusside, nitric oxide, nitrous oxide)
Anaesthetics (medicines used to produce temporary loss of consciousness (Ex. benzocaine, lidocaine, bupivacaine, mepivacaine)
Medicine used for cancer (Ex. cyclophosphamide, flutamide, rasburicase, ifosfamide, hydroxyurea)
Antibiotics (medicine used to manage infections) (Ex. dapsone, sulfonamides, nitrofurantoin, para-aminosalicylic acid)
Medicine used to manage malaria (Ex. quinine, chloroquine, primaquine)
Medicine used to manage fits (Ex. phenytoin, sodium valproate, phenobarbital)
Acetaminophen (used to manage pain and fever)
Metoclopramide (used to manage nausea and vomiting)
Sulfasalazine (used to manage ulcerative colitis and Chron’s disease)
Oral laxatives (used to manage constipation) (Ex. lactulose)
Antiarrhythmics (used to manage irregular heartbeats) (Ex. quinidine)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally ingested or used too much of SMUTH CREAM, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital.

introduction:
Introduction About ANOBLISS CREAM

ANOBLISS CREAM is a combination of Lignocaine and Nifedipine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Local anaesthetics and Calcium channel blockers. It is used to relieve pain and relax muscles during the management or examination of anal fissures, thrombosed external haemorrhoids, post-haemorrhoidectomy, anal sphincter hypertonia, etc.

An anal fissure is a small cut or tear in the delicate lining of the anus that occurs when passing hard or large stools, causing pain and bleeding during bowel movements. Sometimes the pain caused by the anal fissure leads to contraction of the muscle that controls bowel movements and frequent bowel movements.

Before applying ANOBLISS CREAM, inform your doctor if you have severely injured mucosa, inflammation of the areas in the rectum, diabetes, liver or kidney cardiac insufficiency, etc. Pregnant (especially during the first trimester) and breastfeeding women should use ANOBLISS CREAM with caution.

ANOBLISS CREAM is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before applying. The common side effects of ANOBLISS CREAM are pain, burning sensations, itching, hyperemia and bleeding. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

How ANOBLISS CREAM Works

Lignocaine is a local anaesthetic that numbs the area where you have applied it by stopping nerves from sending pain signals to the brain. Nifedipine is a calcium channel blocker that relaxes the muscles in the anal opening. This collective action is useful for relieving pain and healing anal fissures.
usageDetails:
How to use ANOBLISS CREAM

Apply ANOBLISS CREAM as advised by your physician. It is for rectal use only. Wash your hands before use and if possible, use a finger covering, such as a plastic wrap, cling film, a finger cot or a disposable glove. Apply the medicine to the anal region as advised by your doctor. Your doctor will determine the correct dose and duration of management for you based on your age and the severity of your existing condition.

PILORUTE CREAM is a combination of Calcium Dobesilate, Hydrocortisone Acetate, Lignocaine, Phenylephrine, Troxerutin and Zinc Oxide which belong to the group of medicines called Anti-haemorrhoids. PILORUTE CREAM is also used to manage proctitis (inflammation of lining of rectum) and painful evacuation. PILORUTE CREAM is not recommended for use if you have tuberculous or fungal lesions or skin vaccinia (viral infection), chicken pox and acute herpes simplex infection. Consult with your doctor before using it.

PILORUTE CREAM should be used with caution in patients with lung, liver and heart problems. PILORUTE CREAM should be used during pregnancy only if clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before using it.

PILORUTE CREAM is not recommended for use in children under 12 years of age. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of using PILORUTE CREAM are burning, irritation, redness, itchiness at the application site. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

How PILORUTE CREAM Works

Phenylephrine belongs to the group of decongestants that works by shrinking the swollen blood vessels and eventually relieving site irritation and itching in piles. Zinc oxide is an astringent, which helps to reduce painful swelling and shrink the haemorrhoids. It also protects the skin on the anus from infections. Thus PILORUTE CREAM helps to shrink pile mass and heals anal fissure effectively.

introduction:
Introduction About ANOSUM CREAM

ANOSUM CREAM is a combination of Lignocaine, Metronidazole and Sucralfate which belongs to the group of medicines called Local anaesthetics, Nitroimidazoles amd Cytoprotective agents. It is used in the management of bedsores (injuries that happen on areas of the skin under pressure for a prolonged time), haemorrhoids (swollen and inflamed veins in the anus that cause discomfort, bleeding and itching) and fistulae (infected tunnel between the skin and the anus).

It also helps to manage pain, swelling and discharge of blood or pus from the anus, known as anal fissures (a small cut or tear in the delicate lining of the anus that occurs when passing hard or large stools, causing pain and bleeding during bowel movements along with increased frequency).

While using ANOSUM CREAM, avoid contact with the eyes. If contact occurs, immediately wash it out with water or saline. Before using ANOSUM CREAM, inform your doctor if you have irritated skin. ANOSUM CREAM should be used with caution in pregnant women, breastfeeding women, children, adolescents (below 18 years of age) and elderly patients.

The common side effects of ANOSUM CREAM are dry skin, redness, itching, skin rash, pain, a burning sensation and the appearance of red, itchy welts on the skin surface. If any of these symptoms become worse, contact your doctor for advice.

mechanismOfAction:

Introduction About SITCOM LD CREAM

SITCOM LD CREAM is a combination of Lignocaine and Euphorbia prostrata Extract which belongs to the group of medicines called Topical local anesthetic agents and Anorectal preparations respectively. It is indicated for topical management of painful anal fissures and fistula associated with hemorrhoids. Piles or hemorrhoids is a painful swelling that causes discomfort, itching or bleeding in the anal region and also causes difficulty in passing stools. Symptoms include pain or itching sensation in the anal region, pain full swelling, bleeding from the anal region.

Your doctor may advise you to avoid foods rich in fats, sugar or carbohydrates but might suggest consuming dietary supplements and foods rich in fibers such as wheat, bran, prunes, barley, apples, corn, pears, cereals, sweet potato, broccoli, beans, lentils. Your doctor may also advise self-care management with ice packs or cold compressions, and sitz baths (to sit in a few inches of lukewarm water for 10 min) to reduce pain, swelling and bleeding. Do not apply SITCOM LD CREAM if you have a bleeding disorder (uncontrolled bleeding), severe liver disease.

Before using SITCOM LD CREAM inform your doctor if you have methemoglobinemia (increased methemoglobin level in the blood), G6PD deficiency, heart diseases, lung diseases, low red blood cells or hemoglobin. There are no well controlled studies available regarding use of SITCOM LD CREAM in pregnant women and nursing mothers. The common side effects of SITCOM LD CREAM may include nausea, dyspepsia, abdominal pain, gastralgia, gastritis, diarrhoea, dizziness, headache, contact dermatitis, allergic reaction, hypersensitivity and dry mouth. Consult your doctor immediately or visit a nearby hospital, if any of the symptoms worsen or persists for a longer duration.

Introduction About CREMA ANO CREAM

CREMA ANO CREAM is a combination of Lignocaine, Metronidazole and Sucralfate which belongs to the group of medicines called Local anaesthetics, Nitroimidazoles amd Cytoprotective agents. It is used in the management of bedsores (injuries that happen on areas of the skin under pressure for a prolonged time), haemorrhoids (swollen and inflamed veins in the anus that cause discomfort, bleeding and itching) and fistulae (infected tunnel between the skin and the anus).

It also helps to manage pain, swelling and discharge of blood or pus from the anus, known as anal fissures (a small cut or tear in the delicate lining of the anus that occurs when passing hard or large stools, causing pain and bleeding during bowel movements along with increased frequency).

While using CREMA ANO CREAM, avoid contact with the eyes. If contact occurs, immediately wash it out with water or saline. Before using CREMA ANO CREAM, inform your doctor if you have irritated skin. CREMA ANO CREAM should be used with caution in pregnant women, breastfeeding women, children, adolescents (below 18 years of age) and elderly patients.

The common side effects of CREMA ANO CREAM are dry skin, redness, itching, skin rash, pain, a burning sensation and the appearance of red, itchy welts on the skin surface. If any of these symptoms become worse, contact your doctor for advice.

Introduction About PEGMINI POWDER

Pegmini Powder is a laxative used to relieve occasional constipation and produce bowel movement in 1-3 days. It contains Polyethylene Glycol 3350 as active ingredient.

Introduction About RUTICOOL CREAM

RUTICOOL CREAM is a combination of Calcium Dobesilate, Hydrocortisone Acetate, Lignocaine, Phenylephrine, Troxerutin and Zinc Oxide which belong to the group of medicines called Anti-haemorrhoids. It is indicated for pain and bleeding associated with anal fissures (a small tear in the lining of anus), haemorrhoids or piles (lumps inside or around your anus), after haemorrhoids removal surgery and in management of recurrence of piles following surgery.

RUTICOOL CREAM is also used to manage proctitis (inflammation of lining of rectum) and painful evacuation. RUTICOOL CREAM is not recommended for use if you have tuberculous or fungal lesions or skin vaccinia (viral infection), chicken pox and acute herpes simplex infection. Consult with your doctor before using it.

RUTICOOL CREAM should be used with caution in patients with lung, liver and heart problems. RUTICOOL CREAM should be used during pregnancy only if clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before using it.

RUTICOOL CREAM is not recommended for use in children under 12 years of age. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of using RUTICOOL CREAM are burning, irritation, redness, itchiness at the application site. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

How RUTICOOL CREAM Works

Troxerutin and Calcium Dobesilate are vasoprotective medicine that works by strengthening the blood vessels at the affected site and also promote fast healing. Phenylephrine belongs to the group of decongestants that works by shrinking the swollen blood vessels and eventually relieving site irritation and itching in piles. Zinc oxide is an astringent, which helps to reduce painful swelling and shrink the haemorrhoids. It also protects the skin on the anus from infections. Thus RUTICOOL CREAM helps to shrink pile mass and heals anal fissure effectively.

Introduction About CORECT SUPPOSITORIES

Corect is a unique suppository preparation for the treatment of piles and fissures. It provides relief from pain, discomfort and swelling of the inflamed rectum and colon. It contains Hydrocortisone, Lidocaine, Zinc oxide and Allantoin as active ingredients.  

Hydrocortisone is a steroid medicine. It manages the release of certain chemicals within the body that causes pain and inflammation. When inserted inside the rectum, it reduces pain, discomfort and swelling caused by haemorrhoids.

Lidocaine (also known as lignocaine) is an anaesthetic medicine. When inserted inside the rectum, it numbs the site of application, which provides relief from itching, irritation and discomfort associated with haemorrhoids.

Zinc oxide is a mild antiseptic and an astringent agent. It soothes skin irritation, itching, inflammation and redness and manages the risk of skin infections. Allantoin forms a protective barrier over the skin which seals moisture and protects the skin from external irritants.

Use CORECT Suppositories as advised by your physician. It is rectal use only. Do not swallow. One suppository in the rectum in the morning and night after defecation. Gently push the pointed end of the suppository into the anus as far as possible using your index finger or middle finger. Wash your hands before and after insertion. You can use a cling warp on your fingers while inserting the medicine and discard the wrap after use. Corect can be easily pushed into the rectum hence easy to use. Corect is more convenient and less painful application as compared to conventional creams/ointments delivered through applicators. Corect delivers a complete dose at the site of action. Corect is single dose suppository with no risk of infection.

Try to empty the bowels before inserting the medicine. If needed, suppository can be moistened with water for easy insertion. CORECT Suppositories can be stored at room temperature. It is meant for single use only. In case if the suppository appears to have softened in the pack, refrigerate the pack for 15 minutes before using it.

Introduction About SUCRAL ANO CREAM

SUCRAL ANO CREAM is a combination of Lignocaine and Nifedipine which belongs to the group of medicines called Local anaesthetics, Antibiotics and Antacids. It is used in the management of bedsores (injuries that happen on areas of the skin under pressure for a prolonged time), haemorrhoids (swollen and inflamed veins in the anus that cause discomfort, bleeding and itching) and fistulae (infected tunnel between the skin and the anus).

It also helps to manage pain, swelling and discharge of blood or pus from the anus, known as anal fissures (a small cut or tear in the delicate lining of the anus that occurs when passing hard or large stools, causing pain and bleeding during bowel movements along with increased frequency).

While using SUCRAL ANO CREAM, avoid contact with the eyes. If contact occurs, immediately wash it out with water or saline. Before using SUCRAL ANO CREAM, inform your doctor if you have irritated skin. SUCRAL ANO CREAM should be used with caution in pregnant women, breastfeeding women, children, adolescents (below 18 years of age) and elderly patients.

The common side effects of SUCRAL ANO CREAM are dry skin, redness, itching, skin rash, pain, a burning sensation and the appearance of red, itchy welts on the skin surface. If any of these symptoms become worse, contact your doctor for advice.

Introduction About P COOL CREAM

P COOL CREAM contains Calamine, Lignocaine(lidocaine), and Phenylephrine which belong to the group of medicines called antipruritic,  anaesthetics, and sympathomimetic agents. P COOL CREAM is used in adults to relieve pain and bleeding associated with piles, anal fissures, and haemorrhoids.

Piles (haemorrhoids) are tissue growth in and around the anus due to the enlargement of veins in the lower anus or rectum, which leads to discomfort such as pain, itching, blood in the stool, discomfort when pooping, etc. An anal fissure is a tear or cracks in the lining of the anus or anal canal with symptoms of severe pain while pooping, blood in the poop, etc.

P COOL CREAM is not recommended for use in areas of trauma (injury to the mucosa due to chemical, physical, or thermal injury) or patients with hypersensitivity to the ingredients. Before using P COOL CREAM, inform your doctor if you have any heart diseases, increased blood pressure, diabetes, an enlarged prostate gland, thyroid problems, etc.

P COOL CREAM should be used with caution in patients who are pregnant, breastfeeding, elderly, or have children. Possible side effects of P COOL CREAM are irritation, headache, rectal bleeding, anxiety, skin dryness, etc. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms are worsening.

mechanismOfAction:
How P COOL CREAM Works

P COOL CREAM contains calamine, lignocaine (lidocaine), and phenylephrine. Calamine relieves itching and soothes the skin. When applied to the skin, the aqueous component of calamine lotion evaporates. The heat required for evaporation is taken from the body, which gives a cooling effect at the site of application.

Calamine has antibacterial properties, which help manage infections. Phenylephrine is a decongestant that shrinks swollen blood vessels. Enlarged blood vessels result in piles, so phenylephrine helps manage the symptoms of burning, itching, and swelling associated with piles. Lidocaine blocks the pain alerts from the nerves to the brain, thereby decreasing the feeling of pain.

Always use P COOL CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Do not use it on your eyes. Take a small amount of P COOL CREAM in a fingercot. Insert it slowly into the anal opening and apply with gentle rotation. You can also apply P COOL CREAM with a penta applicator.

For that, remove the cap of the tube and insert the Penta applicator into the tube. Insert this into the anal opening. Push the medicine from behind slowly. Remove the applicator and clean it after separating it from the tube. Do not share your applicator with anyone else. Your doctor will determine the required dose and duration of P COOL CREAM for you as per your age and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About LOGISIL H CREAM

LOGISIL H CREAM is a combination of Calcium Dobesilate, Hydrocortisone Acetate, Lignocaine and Zinc Oxide which belong to the group of medicines called Anti-haemorrhoids. It is used to manage haemorrhoids or piles (lumps inside or around your anus) and anal fissures (a small tear in the lining of anus) and constipation.

LOGISIL H CREAM is not recommended for use if you have tuberculous or fungal lesions or skin vaccinia (viral infection), varicella (chicken pox) and acute herpes simplex infection. Consult with your doctor before using it. LOGISIL H CREAM should be used with caution in patients with lung, liver and heart problems. LOGISIL H CREAM can be used during pregnancy only if clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before using the medicine.

LOGISIL H CREAM is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 12 years of age. It should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of using LOGISIL H CREAM are burning, irritation, redness, itchiness at the application site. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How LOGISIL H CREAM Works

Calcium Dobesilate is a vasoprotective medicine that works by strengthening the blood vessels at the affected site and also promote fast healing. Lignocaine is a local anaesthetic which blocks the transmission of pain signals from nerves to brain and Hydrocortisone belongs to the class of steroids works by decreasing itching, inflammation, redness and swelling. Zinc oxide is an astringent, which helps to reduce painful swelling and shrink the haemorrhoids. It also protects the skin on the anus from infections. Thus LOGISIL H CREAM helps to shrink pile mass and heals anal fissure effectively.
usageDetails:
How to use LOGISIL H CREAM

Apply LOGISIL H CREAM as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands before and after use. Apply a thin layer of this medicine over the affected area with the help of an applicator or as directed by physician. Avoid the medicine in contact with your eyes, ears, nose or mouth. If accidental exposure occurs, wash your eyes with water and seek immediate medical attention.
